name: auricle
description: The listener for voice agents: browser voice activity detection, turn taking and barge-in in Rust and WebAssembly. Drop-in for vad-web.

paragraphs: The listener for voice agents, in the browser. Voice activity detection, turn taking, barge-in and ducking as one Rust program compiled to WebAssembly, with an adapter for any OpenAI-compatible speech-to-text, chat and text-to-speech API. No inference runtime, no model files to copy, one import to switch from @ricky0123/vad-web.

The detector that ships is Auricle v1, trained from scratch for the thing a general detector does not do: with a second talker in the room, 94.2% foreground F1 and a 35% background false-alarm rate against Silero v6's 89.4% and 82%, at equal accuracy on human-labelled single-speaker audio, tested on seven languages. Every number, with its reproduce command, is in docs/COMPARISON.md; the model is in docs/MODELCARD.md.
Try the demo: record segments with no key, or paste a Groq key and hold a conversation you can interrupt mid-sentence.
